goal.sl: Povleci notranjo kontrolno točko, nato še krajiščno. Opazuj, kako prvi premik spremeni ukrivljenost, pri drugem pa ji sledi pripadajoče krajišče krivulje. Štiri točke določajo kubično krivuljo: notranje jo usmerjajo, krajišči pa ležita na njej.
goal.en: Drag an interior control, then drag an endpoint control. Watch the curve bend in the first move and the matching endpoint follow in the second. The four controls make a cubic: interior controls guide the path, while the endpoints lie on it.

title.sl: Bézierjeva krivulja: od točk do oblike
title.en: Bézier curve: from points to shape

goal.sl: Bézierjeva krivulja je določena s kontrolnimi točkami. Točke niso nujno na krivulji; vplivajo na njeno obliko.
goal.en: A Bézier curve is determined by control points. The points do not all lie on the curve; they influence its shape.

goal.sl: Premakni parameter od sredine proti levemu krajišču in nato proti desnemu; vseh pet kontrolnih točk pusti pri miru. Opazuj označeno točko na kvartični krivulji; enaki koraki parametra ne pomenijo enakih razdalj. Primer s petimi točkami sodi v isto družino kot prej obravnavani kubični primer, le da ima eno točko več in za eno višjo predstavitveno stopnjo.
goal.en: Move the parameter from the midpoint toward the left endpoint and then the right endpoint, keeping all five controls fixed. Watch the marked point travel along the quartic curve; equal parameter steps need not cover equal distances. This five-control example uses the same family as the earlier cubic, with one more control and one higher representation degree.

goal.sl: Začni pri sredinskem parametru in ga premakni proti krajišču. Sledi krajšanju vsake vrstice za eno točko in premiku končne točke. Pri petih kontrolnih točkah so štirje krogi interpolacije: isto pravilo kot pri izpeljavi kvadratne krivulje s tremi točkami, razširjeno za dva kroga do stopnje štiri.
goal.en: Start at the midpoint and move the parameter toward an endpoint. Follow how each row shortens by one point and how the final point moves. With five controls there are four interpolation rounds: the same rule as the three-control quadratic derivation, extended by two rounds to degree four.

goal.sl: De Casteljaujeva konstrukcija vsako vrstico zgradi z linearno interpolacijo sosednjih točk pri istem \(t\). Začnemo s kvadratno krivuljo s kontrolnimi točkami \((-3,-2)\), \((0,4)\), \((3,-2)\) pri \(t=1/2\).
goal.en: De Casteljau’s construction builds each row by linearly interpolating neighboring points at the same \(t\). We start with the quadratic curve with control points \((-3,-2)\), \((0,4)\), \((3,-2)\) at \(t=1/2\).

goal.sl: Začnemo s kubično krivuljo s kontrolnimi točkami \(p_0=(-4,-2)\), \(p_1=(-2,4)\), \(p_2=(2,2)\), \(p_3=(4,-2)\); ni zrcalno simetrična. Prva pomožna kvadratna krivulja \(Q_1\) uporabi \(p_0,p_1,p_2\), druga \(Q_2\) pa \(p_1,p_2,p_3\). Pri \(t=\tfrac12\) sta uteži enaki, torej je \(B(\tfrac12)\) na sredini daljice med \(Q_1(\tfrac12)\) in \(Q_2(\tfrac12)\).
goal.en: We start with a cubic curve with control points \(p_0=(-4,-2)\), \(p_1=(-2,4)\), \(p_2=(2,2)\), \(p_3=(4,-2)\); it is not mirror symmetric. The first helper quadratic curve \(Q_1\) uses \(p_0,p_1,p_2\), the second \(Q_2\) uses \(p_1,p_2,p_3\). At \(t=\tfrac12\) the weights are equal, so \(B(\tfrac12)\) is at the midpoint of the segment between \(Q_1(\tfrac12)\) and \(Q_2(\tfrac12)\).

goal.sl: Pri stopnji dve primerjaj levo krajiščno, srednjo in desno krajiščno funkcijo po njihovi obliki: vsaka krajiščna doseže vrednost ena na svojem koncu, srednja pa je na obeh koncih enaka nič in največja na sredini. Zvišaj stopnjo na tri in opazuj dodatno funkcijo. To so uteži, ne koordinate krivulje; kvadratna krivulja s stopnjo dve uporablja tri kontrolne točke.
goal.en: At degree two, compare the left endpoint function, the central function, and the right endpoint function by their shapes: each endpoint function reaches one at its own end, while the central one is zero at both ends and highest at the midpoint. Raise the degree to three and notice the extra function. These are weights, not curve coordinates; the degree-two quadratic uses three controls.

goal.sl: Stopnja 1 ima dve funkciji: \(B^1_0(t)=1-t\) in \(B^1_1(t)=t\). Ena pada, druga narašča, skupaj pa dasta 1.
goal.en: Degree 1 has two functions: \(B^1_0(t)=1-t\) and \(B^1_1(t)=t\). One decreases, the other increases, and together they give 1.

goal.sl: Premakni notranjo kontrolno točko ter opazuj, kako se skupaj spremenijo kontrolni poligon, osenčena ovojnica in krivulja. Preveri, da krivulja ostane v ovojnici. Slika pokaže primere; nenegativni koeficienti z vsoto ena pojasnijo vsebovanost za vsak \(t\in[0,1]\).
goal.en: Move an interior control and watch the control polygon, shaded hull, and curve update together. Check that the curve stays inside the hull. This picture shows examples; nonnegative coefficients summing to one explain containment for every \(t\in[0,1]\).

goal.sl: Na pripravljenem kubičnem primeru najprej uporabi premik, nato preizkusi še vrtenje ali spremembo merila. Opazuj, kako se kontrolni poligon in krivulja skupaj premakneta ali zavrtita ter ohranita isti odnos. Afina preslikava kontrolnih točk preslika tudi vsako točko krivulje, ker je vsota Bernsteinovih uteži ena.
goal.en: Apply a translation, then try a rotation or scale on the prepared cubic example. Watch the control polygon and curve move or turn together, keeping the same relationship. An affine map of the controls maps every point of the curve because the Bernstein weights sum to one.

title.en: Affine transformations of a Bézier curve

goal.sl: Začnemo s kubično krivuljo s kontrolnimi točkami \((1,0),(2,3),(4,2),(5,-1)\). Ni zrcalno simetrična, označena točka \(B(\tfrac{1}{2})=\left(3,\tfrac{7}{4}\right)\) pa je daleč od izhodišča. Afina preslikava lahko spremeni lego, orientacijo ali merilo krivulje, vendar uporablja isto preslikavo za vse kontrolne točke.
goal.en: We start with a cubic curve with control points \((1,0),(2,3),(4,2),(5,-1)\). It is not mirror symmetric, and the marked point \(B(\tfrac{1}{2})=\left(3,\tfrac{7}{4}\right)\) is far from the origin. An affine map can change position, orientation, or scale while using the same map for every control point.

title.en: Degree elevation without changing the curve

goal.sl: Kubična Bézierjeva krivulja ima štiri kontrolne točke. Višanje stopnje bo dodalo peto točko, vendar naj bi narisana krivulja ostala ista. Polni poligon \(P_0,\dots,P_3\) pripada krivulji, črtkani poligon s petimi točkami \(Q_0,\dots,Q_4\) pa je poligon višane predstavitve iste krivulje.
goal.en: A cubic Bézier curve has four control points. Degree elevation will add a fifth point, while the drawn curve should stay the same. The solid polygon \(P_0,\dots,P_3\) belongs to the curve; the dashed five-point polygon \(Q_0,\dots,Q_4\) is the polygon of the elevated representation of the same curve.

goal.sl: Prikazana je privzeta krivulja s shemo pri \(t=\tfrac12\). Shema ima tri vrstice vmesnih točk in na koncu točko \(B(t)\) na krivulji. Isto shemo bomo uporabili za rez.
goal.en: The default curve is shown with its scheme at \(t=\tfrac12\). The scheme has three rows of intermediate points and ends with the point \(B(t)\) on the curve. We will use the same scheme for the cut.

goal.sl: Za začetek je ena krivulja s štirimi kontrolnimi točkami in prikazanim kontrolnim poligonom. Poligon je od krivulje precej oddaljen: največja razdalja \(d_0\) je približno 2,38.
goal.en: To begin there is one curve with four control points and its control polygon shown. The polygon is quite far from the curve: the largest distance \(d_0\) is about 2.38.

goal.sl: Na privzeti krivulji je prikazana točka pri \(t=\tfrac65\). Ker je \(t>1\), leži zunaj narisanega loka: to je točka \(B(\tfrac65)\) podaljška krivulje.
goal.en: On the default curve a point at \(t=\tfrac65\) is shown. Because \(t>1\), it lies outside the drawn arc: it is the point \(B(\tfrac65)\) of the continuation of the curve.

goal.sl: Spremeni stopnjo z izbirnikom in opazuj, kako se spremeni število ter oblika uteži. Pri stopnji \(n\) jih je \(n+1\); vse skupaj povedo, kako se delež porazdeli po parametru.
goal.en: Change the degree with its selector and watch the number and shape of the weights. Degree \(n\) has \(n+1\) weights; together they show how contribution is distributed across the parameter.

goal.sl: Stopnja 1 ima dve funkciji: \(B^1_0(t)=1-t\) in \(B^1_1(t)=t\). Ena pada, druga narašča, skupaj pa dasta 1.
goal.en: Degree 1 has two functions: \(B^1_0(t)=1-t\) and \(B^1_1(t)=t\). One decreases, the other increases, and together they give 1.

goal.sl: Izberi stopnjo dve in primerjaj tri narisane funkcije z zapisi v formuli. Njihova nenegativnost in vsota ena pojasnita, zakaj so uteži primerne za tehtano povprečje.
goal.en: Select degree two and compare the three plotted functions with the formula. Their nonnegativity and sum of one explain why these weights form a weighted average.

goal.en: Change the degree to two and then three: compare the three quadratic weights with the four cubic weights in the figure above. The worked point \((2,1)\) uses three control points and quadratic weights.

goal.sl: Stopnja 1 ima dve funkciji: \(B^1_0(t)=1-t\) in \(B^1_1(t)=t\). Ena pada, druga narašča, skupaj pa dasta 1.

goal.sl: Vključi prikaz zmnožka in argumentov. Nato spremeni argument faktorja \(w\) z njegovim polarnim vnosom: točka zmnožka se zavrti, njen prikazani argument pa je vsota argumentov faktorjev modulo \(2\pi\).
goal.en: Reveal the product and arguments. Then change the argument of factor \(w\) with its polar input: the product point rotates, and its displayed argument is the sum of the factor arguments modulo \(2\pi\).

goal.sl: Število \(a+bi\) ustreza točki \((a,b)\) v ravnini: \(a\) je realni, \(b\) imaginarni del. Število \(i\) je točka \((0,1)\) in velja \(i^2=-1\). Modul \(|z|\) je razdalja od izhodišča, argument \(\arg z\) pa kot od pozitivne realne osi do puščice. Na grafu sta \(z=1+i\) (krog) in \(w=i\) (kvadrat), loka kažeta njuna argumenta. Zmnožek je še skrit.
goal.en: The number \(a+bi\) corresponds to the point \((a,b)\) in the plane: \(a\) is the real and \(b\) the imaginary part. The number \(i\) is the point \((0,1)\) and \(i^2=-1\). The modulus \(|z|\) is the distance from the origin and the argument \(\arg z\) is the angle from the positive real axis to the arrow. The graph shows \(z=1+i\) (circle) and \(w=i\) (square), and the arcs show their arguments. The product is still hidden.

goal.sl: Z izbirnikom stopnje nastavi dve, nato tri. Primerjaj tri kvadratne in štiri kubične uteži: stopnja določi število baznih funkcij, njihova vsota ena pa omogoča uteženo povprečje kontrolnih točk.
goal.en: Set the degree to two and then three. Compare three quadratic weights with four cubic weights: the degree determines the number of basis functions, and their sum of one lets them form a weighted average of control points.

goal.sl: Izberi krivuljo in z gumboma za prejšnjo ali naslednjo utež poišči drugo utež, označeno \(w_1\). Spremeni njeno vrednostno polje ali uporabi gumba za povečanje in zmanjšanje; opazuj, kako se krivulja približa kontrolni točki \(P_1\) ali se od nje odmakne, ker se spremeni njen relativni vpliv.

goal.sl: Kontrolne točke so \(\left(-4,\,-3\right)\), \(\left(-3,\,3\right)\), \(\left(3,\,3\right)\), \(\left(4,\,-3\right)\); do konca lekcije ostanejo na istih mestih, parameter pa je vedno \(t=\tfrac{1}{2}\). Pri utežeh \(\left(1,\,1,\,1,\,1\right)\) je imenovalec \(1\) in dobimo navadno Bézierjevo krivuljo z označeno točko \(\left(0,\,\tfrac{3}{2}\right)\).
goal.en: The control points are \(\left(-4,\,-3\right)\), \(\left(-3,\,3\right)\), \(\left(3,\,3\right)\), \(\left(4,\,-3\right)\); they stay in place until the end of the lesson, and the parameter is always \(t=\tfrac{1}{2}\). With the weights \(\left(1,\,1,\,1,\,1\right)\) the denominator is \(1\) and we get the ordinary Bézier curve with the marked point \(\left(0,\,\tfrac{3}{2}\right)\).

goal.sl: Premakni drsnik za parameter \(t\). Opazuj krajišče \(R(t)\) naraščajočega dela krivulje: prikaz pokaže, kako racionalni De Casteljaujev postopek določi točko pri izbranem parametru.
goal.en: Move the parameter slider \(t\). Watch the endpoint \(R(t)\) of the growing curve prefix: the display shows how rational De Casteljau evaluation finds the point at the chosen parameter.

goal.sl: Začnemo s kvadratno krivuljo s kontrolnimi točkami \((-4,-3),(0,3),(4,-3)\), da je izračun krajši. Pri utežeh \((1,1,1)\) so homogene točke \((-4,-3,1),(0,3,1),(4,-3,1)\); zadnja koordinata ostane \(1\), prvi dve pa se interpolirata kot pri navadni De Casteljaujevi konstrukciji: pri \(t=\tfrac{1}{2}\) dobimo \((-2,0)\), \((2,0)\) in končno točko \((0,0)\).
goal.en: We start with a quadratic curve with control points \((-4,-3),(0,3),(4,-3)\) to keep the calculation short. With the weights \((1,1,1)\) the homogeneous points are \((-4,-3,1),(0,3,1),(4,-3,1)\); the last coordinate stays \(1\) and the first two are interpolated exactly as in the ordinary De Casteljau construction: at \(t=\tfrac{1}{2}\) we get \((-2,0)\), \((2,0)\) and the final point \((0,0)\).

goal.sl: S števcem »Število krivulj« spreminjaj število kosov med \(3\) in \(12\). Opazuj, kako se krožnica razdeli na več ali manj racionalnih lokov, medtem ko se celotna krožnica ohrani.
goal.en: Change the piece count with “Number of curves,” from \(3\) to \(12\). Watch the circle split into more or fewer rational arcs while the complete circle stays the same.

goal.sl: Privzeti graf nariše krog s polmerom 3 iz treh racionalnih kvadratnih kosov. Vsak kos je lok 120°, njegove kontrolne točke pa so dve točki na krožnici in presečišče tangent v njiju zunaj kroga, na razdalji 6 od središča. Pogled je razširjen, da so vidne tudi te točke.
goal.en: The default graph draws a circle of radius 3 from three rational quadratic pieces. Each piece is a 120 degree arc, and its control points are two points on the circle and the intersection of the tangents at them outside the circle, at distance 6 from the center. The view is widened so that these points are visible too.

goal.en: Click “Elevate degree.” The display gains control data while the curve keeps the same geometric trace; the representation changes, not the shape.

goal.sl: Premakni drsnik parametra čez \(1\) in opazuj ekstrapolacijsko točko, nato po želji klikni »Ekstrapoliraj«. Zunaj \([0,1]\) Bernsteinove funkcije lahko postanejo negativne, zato pozitivne kontrolne uteži same ne zagotavljajo neničelnega imenovalca.
goal.en: Move the parameter slider beyond \(1\) and watch the extrapolation point, then click “Extrapolate” if you wish. Outside \([0,1]\), Bernstein functions can become negative, so positive control weights alone do not guarantee a nonzero denominator.

goal.sl: Privzeta racionalna krivulja ima uteži \((1,2,1,1)\). Točka pri \(t=\tfrac65\) leži zunaj narisanega loka: racionalna funkcija \(B\) je tam še vedno definirana, ker je njen imenovalec \(D(s)\) pozitiven na vsem intervalu \([0,\tfrac65]\) (najmanj 1).

goal.sl: Racionalna Bézierjeva krivulja ima pri vsaki kontrolni točki utež \(w_i>0\). Privzeta krivulja ima uteži \(1,2,1,1\): druga kontrolna točka ima dvojno utež in krivuljo vleče bliže k sebi.
goal.en: A rational Bézier curve has a weight \(w_i>0\) at each control point. The default curve has weights \(1,2,1,1\): the second control point has double weight and pulls the curve closer to itself.

goal.sl: Izberi krivuljo in z gumboma za prejšnjo ali naslednjo utež poišči drugo utež, označeno \(w_1\). Spremeni njeno vrednostno polje ali uporabi gumba za povečanje in zmanjšanje; opazuj, kako se krivulja približa kontrolni točki \(P_1\) ali se od nje odmakne, ker se spremeni njen relativni vpliv.
goal.en: Select the curve and use the Previous or Next weight controls to choose the second weight, shown as \(w_1\). Change its value field or use the increase/decrease buttons; watch the curve move toward or away from control point \(P_1\) as its relative influence changes.

goal.sl: Premakni drsnik za parameter \(t\). Opazuj krajišče \(R(t)\) naraščajočega dela krivulje: prikaz pokaže, kako racionalni De Casteljaujev postopek določi točko pri izbranem parametru.
goal.en: Move the parameter slider \(t\). Watch the endpoint \(R(t)\) of the growing curve prefix: the display shows how rational De Casteljau evaluation finds the point at the chosen parameter.

goal.sl: Klikni »Dvigni stopnjo«. Prikaz dobi dodatne kontrolne podatke, krivulja pa ohrani isto geometrijsko sled; spremeni se predstavitev, ne oblika.
goal.en: Click “Elevate degree.” The display gains control data while the curve keeps the same geometric trace; the representation changes, not the shape.

goal.sl: Premakni drsnik parametra čez \(1\) in opazuj ekstrapolacijsko točko, nato po želji klikni »Ekstrapoliraj«. Zunaj \([0,1]\) Bernsteinove funkcije lahko postanejo negativne, zato pozitivne kontrolne uteži same ne zagotavljajo neničelnega imenovalca.
goal.en: Move the parameter slider beyond \(1\) and watch the extrapolation point, then click “Extrapolate” if you wish. Outside \([0,1]\), Bernstein functions can become negative, so positive control weights alone do not guarantee a nonzero denominator.

goal.sl: Izberi parameter reza in klikni »Subdividiraj«. Pojavita se dve racionalni krivulji; skupaj sledita prvotni krivulji na levem in desnem delu intervala.
goal.en: Choose a split parameter and click “Subdivide.” Two rational curves appear; together they trace the original curve over the left and right parts of its interval.

goal.sl: Vključi stikalo »Farinove točke« in opazuj, kje razdelijo kontrolne stranice. Te točke so drugačen opis iste racionalne konstrukcije in razkrivajo smerno oziroma tangentno strukturo.
goal.en: Turn on “Farin points” and watch where they divide the control edges. These points give another description of the same rational construction and expose its directional or tangent structure.

goal.sl: S števcem »Število krivulj« spreminjaj število kosov med \(3\) in \(12\). Opazuj, kako se krožnica razdeli na več ali manj racionalnih lokov, medtem ko se celotna krožnica ohrani.
goal.en: Change the piece count with “Number of curves,” from \(3\) to \(12\). Watch the circle split into more or fewer rational arcs while the complete circle stays the same.

goal.sl: Kontrolne točke so \(\left(-4,\,-3\right)\), \(\left(-3,\,3\right)\), \(\left(3,\,3\right)\), \(\left(4,\,-3\right)\); do konca lekcije ostanejo na istih mestih, parameter pa je vedno \(t=\tfrac{1}{2}\). Pri utežeh \(\left(1,\,1,\,1,\,1\right)\) je imenovalec \(1\) in dobimo navadno Bézierjevo krivuljo z označeno točko \(\left(0,\,\tfrac{3}{2}\right)\).
goal.en: The control points are \(\left(-4,\,-3\right)\), \(\left(-3,\,3\right)\), \(\left(3,\,3\right)\), \(\left(4,\,-3\right)\); they stay in place until the end of the lesson, and the parameter is always \(t=\tfrac{1}{2}\). With the weights \(\left(1,\,1,\,1,\,1\right)\) the denominator is \(1\) and we get the ordinary Bézier curve with the marked point \(\left(0,\,\tfrac{3}{2}\right)\).

goal.sl: Začnemo s kvadratno krivuljo s kontrolnimi točkami \((-4,-3),(0,3),(4,-3)\), da je izračun krajši. Pri utežeh \((1,1,1)\) so homogene točke \((-4,-3,1),(0,3,1),(4,-3,1)\); zadnja koordinata ostane \(1\), prvi dve pa se interpolirata kot pri navadni De Casteljaujevi konstrukciji: pri \(t=\tfrac{1}{2}\) dobimo \((-2,0)\), \((2,0)\) in končno točko \((0,0)\).
goal.en: We start with a quadratic curve with control points \((-4,-3),(0,3),(4,-3)\) to keep the calculation short. With the weights \((1,1,1)\) the homogeneous points are \((-4,-3,1),(0,3,1),(4,-3,1)\); the last coordinate stays \(1\) and the first two are interpolated exactly as in the ordinary De Casteljau construction: at \(t=\tfrac{1}{2}\) we get \((-2,0)\), \((2,0)\) and the final point \((0,0)\).

title.en: Degree elevation of a rational curve

goal.sl: Privzeta krivulja ima štiri kontrolne točke in uteži \(\left(1,\,2,\,1,\,1\right)\). Večja utež druge točke krivuljo potegne proti njej.
goal.en: The default curve has four control points and weights \(\left(1,\,2,\,1,\,1\right)\). The larger weight of the second point pulls the curve toward it.

title.en: Subdivision of a rational Bézier curve

goal.sl: Privzeta racionalna krivulja ima iste kontrolne točke kot navadna, uteži pa so \((1,2,1,1)\): druga točka močneje privlači krivuljo. Prikazana je shema pri \(t=\tfrac12\).
goal.en: The default rational curve has the same control points as the ordinary one, and its weights are \((1,2,1,1)\): the second point pulls the curve more strongly. The scheme at \(t=\tfrac12\) is shown.

title.en: Extrapolation of a rational Bézier curve

goal.sl: Privzeta racionalna krivulja ima uteži \((1,2,1,1)\). Točka pri \(t=\tfrac65\) leži zunaj narisanega loka: racionalna funkcija \(B\) je tam še vedno definirana, ker je njen imenovalec \(D(s)\) pozitiven na vsem intervalu \([0,\tfrac65]\) (najmanj 1).
goal.en: The default rational curve has weights \((1,2,1,1)\). The point at \(t=\tfrac65\) lies outside the drawn arc: the rational function \(B\) is still defined there because its denominator \(D(s)\) is positive on the whole interval \([0,\tfrac65]\) (at least 1).

goal.sl: Privzeti graf nariše krog s polmerom 3 iz treh racionalnih kvadratnih kosov. Vsak kos je lok 120°, njegove kontrolne točke pa so dve točki na krožnici in presečišče tangent v njiju zunaj kroga, na razdalji 6 od središča. Pogled je razširjen, da so vidne tudi te točke.
goal.en: The default graph draws a circle of radius 3 from three rational quadratic pieces. Each piece is a 120 degree arc, and its control points are two points on the circle and the intersection of the tangents at them outside the circle, at distance 6 from the center. The view is widened so that these points are visible too.

goal.sl: Premakni prosto kontrolno točko in opazuj, kateri deli zlepka se spremenijo. S števcema spremeni red zveznosti ali stopnjo; dovoljen obseg drugega števca je odvisen od prvega. Vključi oznake točk ali skrij izračunane točke in primerjaj krajevni nadzor z dodatnimi pogoji na spojih.
goal.en: Move a free control point and watch which parts of the spline change. Use the counters to change continuity order or degree; the degree counter’s allowed range depends on the continuity setting. Turn on point labels or hide computed points to compare local control with the extra join constraints.

goal.sl: Zlepek je polinomska krivulja, sestavljena iz Bézierjevih odsekov, ki se stikajo v stičnih točkah (Definicija 4.1). Ta zlepek ima \(4\) proste točke, stopnjo \(n=2\) in zveznost \(r=1\), torej \(2\) kvadratna odseka z eno stično točko. Prvi odsek določajo prve tri proste točke, drugi pa začne v zadnji točki prvega: njegova druga kontrolna točka je izpeljana, zadnja pa je četrta prosta točka. Ko so vključene oznake, ima vsaka točka oznako \(p_i^{(c)}\): \(i\)-ta točka odseka \(c\).
goal.en: A spline is a polynomial curve made of Bézier pieces that meet at joints (Definition 4.1). This spline has \(4\) free points, degree \(n=2\) and continuity \(r=1\), so \(2\) quadratic pieces with one joint. The first piece is set by the first three free points; the second starts at the last point of the first, its middle control point is derived and its last one is the fourth free point. With labels on, each point is labelled \(p_i^{(c)}\): the \(i\)-th point of piece \(c\).

goal.sl: Premakni prosto kontrolno točko in opazuj vpliv na več kosov. Vključi oznake točk ali skrij izračunane točke; izračunani spojni podatki in podporni poligon pomagajo slediti konstrukciji zveznosti \(C^1\), ne preverijo pa sami enačb odvodov.
goal.en: Move a free control point and watch its effect on several pieces. Turn on point labels or hide computed points; the computed join data and supporting polygon help trace the \(C^1\) construction, but do not verify the derivative equations by themselves.

goal.sl: Premakni prosto kontrolno točko in opazuj, kako se prilagodijo sosednji kosi. Vključi oznake točk ali skrij izračunane točke; dodatne izračunane točke in podporni poligon pokažejo konstrukcijo pogoja \(C^2\), ne pa dokaza enačb.
goal.en: Move a free control point and watch the neighboring pieces adjust. Turn on point labels or hide computed points; the extra computed points and supporting polygon show the construction for the \(C^2\) condition, not a proof of its equations.

goal.sl: Najmanjši simetrični zlepek ima \(4\) proste točke in \(2\) kvadratna odseka. Pri simetrični konstrukciji (Algoritem 4, razdelek 4.2.2) so vse točke proste; stična točka med odsekoma je izpeljana in jo računalnik poišče sam.
goal.en: The smallest symmetric spline has \(4\) free points and \(2\) quadratic pieces. In the symmetric construction (Algorithm 4, section 4.2.2) all points are free; the joint between the pieces is derived and found by the program.

goal.sl: Ta zlepek ima \(6\) prostih točk, označenih \(p_0,\dots,p_5\) (v diplomskem delu \(p_{-1},\dots,p_4\)), in \(3\) kubične odseke: pri manj točkah ni srednjega odseka, ki bi imel obe notranji točki na tretjinah. Odseki imajo skupaj \(6\) izpeljanih točk: dve stični, dve notranji točki srednjega odseka in po eno notranjo točko krajnih odsekov.
goal.en: This spline has \(6\) free points labelled \(p_0,\dots,p_5\) (\(p_{-1},\dots,p_4\) in the thesis) and \(3\) cubic pieces: with fewer points there is no middle piece whose two inner points lie at thirds. The pieces share \(6\) derived points: two joints, the two inner points of the middle piece and one inner point for each end piece.

goal.sl: Premakni prosto kontrolno točko in opazuj spremembo oblike. Nato premakni drsnik »Parameter b 1« od nevtralne vrednosti \(1\), na primer proti \(0{,}65\); spoj se spremeni, skupna tangentna smer pa ostane poravnana. To je geometrijski pogoj \(G^1\), ki dopušča različno hitrost.
goal.en: Move a free control point and watch the shape change. Then move the “Parameter b 1” slider away from the neutral value \(1\), for example toward \(0.65\); the join changes while the tangent directions remain aligned. This is the geometric \(G^1\) condition, which allows different speeds.

goal.sl: Premakni prosto kontrolno točko ali enega od drsnikov »Parameter b 1«, »b 2« in »b 3« proti \(0{,}2\). Opazuj tri spoje: vsak parameter spremeni lokalno konstrukcijo, skupna tangentna smer pa ostane poravnana. Simetrična konstrukcija omeji načine spreminjanja sosednjih kosov.
goal.en: Move a free control point or one of the “Parameter b 1,” “b 2,” and “b 3” sliders toward \(0.2\). Watch the three joins: each parameter changes the local construction while the tangent directions stay aligned. The symmetric construction limits how neighboring pieces can vary.

goal.sl: Začnemo z enim stikom. Zlepek ima \(4\) proste točke \(p_0=(-4;\ -1)\), \(p_1=(-2;\ 2)\), \(p_2=(0;\ 0)\), \(p_3=(4;\ -1)\) in \(2\) kvadratna odseka s stikom v \(p_2\); parameter \(b\) je \(1\). Takrat je prva stranica desnega odseka enako dolga kot zadnja stranica levega (\(p_1p_2\)) in zlepek je \(C^1\). Pri \(G^1\) (Definicija 4.2, razdelek 4.1) je dovolj, da imata odseka na stiku isto smer tangente.
goal.en: We start with a single joint. The spline has \(4\) free points \(p_0=(-4,\ -1)\), \(p_1=(-2,\ 2)\), \(p_2=(0,\ 0)\), \(p_3=(4,\ -1)\) and \(2\) quadratic pieces with the joint at \(p_2\); the parameter \(b\) is \(1\). Then the first edge of the right piece is as long as the last edge of the left one (\(p_1p_2\)) and the spline is \(C^1\). For \(G^1\) (Definition 4.2, section 4.1) it is enough that the pieces have the same tangent direction at the joint.

goal.sl: Začnemo z enim stikom. Zlepek ima \(4\) proste točke \(p_0=(-5;\ -1)\), \(p_1=(-2;\ 2)\), \(p_2=(2;\ 0)\), \(p_3=(5;\ 3)\) in \(2\) kvadratna odseka; \(\beta_1=\tfrac12\). Stična točka \(J_1=(0;\ 1)\) je razpolovišče stranice \(p_1p_2\), odvoda na obeh straneh sta enaka, \((8;\ -4)\), zlepek pa je enak simetričnemu \(C^1\) zlepku z istimi točkami.
goal.en: We start with a single joint. The spline has \(4\) free points \(p_0=(-5,\ -1)\), \(p_1=(-2,\ 2)\), \(p_2=(2,\ 0)\), \(p_3=(5,\ 3)\) and \(2\) quadratic pieces; \(\beta_1=\tfrac12\). The joint \(J_1=(0,\ 1)\) is the midpoint of the edge \(p_1p_2\), the derivatives on both sides are equal, \((8,\ -4)\), and the spline equals the symmetric \(C^1\) spline with the same points.

title.en: A worked join of two parabolas

goal.sl: Sledi levemu odseku \(L(t)=(t,t^2)\) in desnemu \(R(s)=(1+s,1+2s+s^2)\). Pri spoju \((1,1)\) primerjaj prve odvode \((1,2)\) in druge odvode \((0,2)\). Kaj se zgodi, če koeficient pri \(s^2\) spremeniš?
goal.en: Follow the left piece \(L(t)=(t,t^2)\) and right piece \(R(s)=(1+s,1+2s+s^2)\). At the join \((1,1)\), compare the first derivatives \((1,2)\) and second derivatives \((0,2)\). What changes if you change the coefficient of \(s^2\)?

title.en: Arc length is an integral of speed

goal.sl: Zajeta slika kubičnega katalogskega primera prikazuje zeleno krivuljo, moder odmik in oranžne točke. V odprtem grafu v zavihku Prikaz vključi odmike, nato v zavihku Uredi spreminjaj njihovo razdaljo in število. Opazuj dolžino izvorne krivulje; povezava odpre graf, ne pa stanja z zajete slike.
goal.en: The cubic catalog capture shows a green curve, blue offset, and orange points. In the open graph, turn offsets on in the Display tab, then change their distance and count in the Edit tab. Watch the source curve’s length; the link opens the graph, not the captured state.

goal.sl: Zajeta slika kvintičnega primera prikazuje zeleno krivuljo, moder odmik in oranžne točke. Primerjaj dolžino izvorne krivulje s kubičnim primerom, ki ima drugo stopnjo in parametrizacijo.
goal.en: The quintic capture shows a green curve, blue offset, and orange points. In the open graph, first turn offsets on in the Display tab; only then look for their settings in the Edit tab. Compare the source curve’s length with the cubic example, which has a different degree and parametrization.

goal.sl: Pri kubični PH-krivulji začetna točka \(P_0\) in generatorja \(w_0\), \(w_1\) določijo odvod, iz odvoda pa se izračunajo kontrolne točke krivulje.
goal.en: For a cubic PH curve, the start point \(P_0\) and generators \(w_0\), \(w_1\) determine the derivative, from which the curve control points are generated.

goal.sl: Scena začne s \(P_0=\left(-2,\,-1\right)\) in tremi generatorji \(w_0=2\), \(w_1=2+i\), \(w_2=1+i\), torej \(w(t)=(2-t^2)+i(2t-t^2)\).

goal.sl: V zavihku Uredi premakni \(w_0\) ali \(w_1\) na ločenem polju urejevalnika hodografa in opazuj, kako se spremenita narisana PH-krivulja ter njen odčitek dolžine. To polje ureja generirne točke; ni narisan hodograf in graf ne naloži izračuna z začetkom v izhodišču.
goal.en: In the Edit tab, move \(w_0\) or \(w_1\) in the separate hodograph editor and watch the drawn PH curve and its length readout change. This field edits generating points; it does not plot the hodograph, and the graph does not load the calculation starting at the origin.

goal.sl: Pri kubični PH-krivulji začetna točka \(P_0\) in generatorja \(w_0\), \(w_1\) določijo odvod, iz odvoda pa se izračunajo kontrolne točke krivulje.

goal.sl: V kubičnem grafu v zavihku Prikaz vključi odmik, nato v zavihku Uredi spremeni njegovo razdaljo. Opazuj, kako se odmik premika, medtem ko odčitek dolžine izvorne krivulje ostaja enak; odmikova dolžina ni ta odčitek. Graf ni izračunani primer z začetkom v izhodišču.
goal.en: In the cubic graph, turn on the offset in the Display tab, then change its distance in the Edit tab. Watch the offset move while the source curve’s length readout stays the same; that readout is not the offset’s length. The graph is not the calculated example starting at the origin.

goal.sl: Pri kubični PH-krivulji začetna točka \(P_0\) in generatorja \(w_0\), \(w_1\) določijo odvod, iz odvoda pa se izračunajo kontrolne točke krivulje.

goal.sl: V kvintičnem grafu najprej v zavihku Prikaz vključi odmik, nato v zavihku Uredi poišči drsnik razdalje. Primerjaj \(d=0{,}5\), \(d=0\) in negativno razdaljo: nič vrne izvorno krivuljo, predznak pa izbere drugo stran glede na izbrano normalo. Število odmikovalnih krivulj nastavi ločeno.
goal.en: In the quintic graph, first turn on the offset in the Display tab, then find the distance slider in the Edit tab. Compare \(d=0.5\), \(d=0\), and a negative distance: zero returns the source curve, and the sign selects the other side relative to the chosen normal. Set the number of offset curves separately.

goal.sl: V kubičnem primeru v zavihku Prikaz vključi odmik, nato v zavihku Uredi spreminjaj predznačeno razdaljo in preveri še ničlo. Opazuj, ali se odmik približa sam sebi ali seka sam sebe; iz kubičnega PH-porekla ne sklepaj na globalno gladkost odmika.

goal.sl: V kvintičnem primeru v zavihku Prikaz omogoči odmik, v zavihku Uredi pa spreminjaj predznačeno razdaljo skozi pozitivne, ničelne in negativne vrednosti. Opazuj, ali se odmik približa ali seka sam sebe, ter primerjaj njegovi strani; odčitek dolžine ostane dolžina izvorne krivulje.

goal.sl: Spremeni drsnik »Parameter α« ali »Število točk« in opazuj razporeditev vidnih vzorčnih točk ter nastali zlepek. Vozlišča niso označena, vendar sprememba eksponenta vpliva na njihovo razporeditev in lahko spremeni geometrijo zlepka.
goal.en: Change the “Parameter α” or “Number of points” slider and watch the visible sample points and resulting spline. Knots are not labeled, but changing the exponent affects their allocation and can change the spline geometry.

goal.sl: Odprt simetrični \(C^2\) zlepek ima \(8\) prostih točk \(p_0,\dots,p_7\) in \(5\) odsekov; stranice so očitno različno dolge. Na njem je \(10\) vzorčnih točk pri enakih korakih \(t_k=\tfrac{k}{11}\) in \(\alpha=\tfrac12\) (centripetalna parametrizacija). Vzorčnih točk na krajiščih \(t=0\) in \(t=1\) ni. Izpeljane točke, med njimi \(4\) stične, so vidne.
goal.en: The open symmetric \(C^2\) spline has \(8\) free points \(p_0,\dots,p_7\) and \(5\) pieces; the edges are clearly of different lengths. It carries \(10\) sample points at equal steps \(t_k=\tfrac{k}{11}\) and \(\alpha=\tfrac12\) (the centripetal parameterization). There are no samples at the ends \(t=0\) and \(t=1\). The derived points, \(4\) of them joints, are visible.

goal.sl: Spremeni drsnik »Parameter α« ali »Število točk« in opazuj razporeditev vidnih vzorčnih točk ter nastali zlepek. Vozlišča niso označena, vendar sprememba eksponenta vpliva na njihovo razporeditev in lahko spremeni geometrijo zlepka.

goal.sl: Na krivulji je \(N\) notranjih vzorčnih točk, ki jih določa Število točk; krajišči \(P_0\) in \(P_3\) nista označeni. Začnemo s \(N=3\) in \(\alpha=\tfrac{1}{2}\): tedaj je \(\varphi_\alpha(t)=t\), točke ležijo pri \(t_i=\tfrac{i}{N+1}=\tfrac{1}{4},\tfrac{1}{2},\tfrac{3}{4}\) in so po parametru enakomerno razporejene. V naslednjih korakih ostanejo kontrolne točke enake, spreminja se le \(\alpha\).
goal.en: The curve carries \(N\) interior sample points set by Number of points; the end points \(P_0\) and \(P_3\) are not marked. We start with \(N=3\) and \(\alpha=\tfrac{1}{2}\): then \(\varphi_\alpha(t)=t\), the points lie at \(t_i=\tfrac{i}{N+1}=\tfrac{1}{4},\tfrac{1}{2},\tfrac{3}{4}\), and they are equally spaced in the parameter. In the next steps the control points stay the same and only \(\alpha\) changes.

goal.sl: S kontrolnikom »Izberi parametrizacijo« preklopi med uteženim in enakomernim načinom; drsnik »Število točk« spremeni gostoto vzorčenja, v uteženem načinu pa spremeni tudi »Parameter α«. Primerjaj položaje vzorcev; odčitek prikazuje dolžino izvorne krivulje, ravne tetive med redkimi vzorci pa ne dokazujejo enakih dolžin lokov.
goal.en: Use “Choose parameterization” to switch between weighted and uniform modes; the “Number of points” slider changes sampling, and weighted mode also offers “Parameter α.” Compare sample locations; the readout is the source curve’s length, and straight chords between sparse samples do not prove equal arc lengths.

title.en: Uniform parameterization of a PH curve

goal.sl: Izbrana je utežena parametrizacija z \(\alpha=\tfrac{1}{2}\) in \(N=3\) notranjimi točkami, zato so te pri \(t_i=\tfrac{i}{N+1}=\tfrac{1}{4},\tfrac{1}{2},\tfrac{3}{4}\). Dolžina loka krivulje je \(L\approx 16{,}72\), enakomerna razporeditev po loku pa bi imela štiri loke po \(\tfrac{L}{4}\approx 4{,}18\). Tu so loki med zaporednimi točkami (vštevši odseka do krajišč) približno \(5{,}92\), \(2{,}43\), \(2{,}43\) in \(5{,}92\).
goal.en: The weighted parameterization with \(\alpha=\tfrac{1}{2}\) and \(N=3\) interior points is selected, so the points sit at \(t_i=\tfrac{i}{N+1}=\tfrac{1}{4},\tfrac{1}{2},\tfrac{3}{4}\). The arc length of the curve is \(L\approx 16.72\), and an even spread along the arc would give four arcs of \(\tfrac{L}{4}\approx 4.18\). Here the arcs between consecutive points (counting the pieces out to the end points) are about \(5.92\), \(2.43\), \(2.43\) and \(5.92\).

goal.en: On the same Bézier curve, change the “Parameter α” slider and watch samples move along the unchanged trace. At the neutral parameter value \(\alpha=0.5\), samples correspond to equal steps of the original parameter; changing from \(\alpha=0.25\) moves them along the same trace.

title.en: Functions are rules with a domain

goal.sl: Premakni eno od obeh točk na grafu ali spremeni njene koordinate; nato spremeni še naklon \(k\) ali začetno vrednost \(n\). Opazuj pravokotni trikotnik spremembe, enačbo in prikazana \(\Delta x,\Delta y\). Kako premik ene točke spremeni naklon, kadar točki nimata iste abscise in določata neničelno spremembo vhoda?
goal.en: Drag either point on the graph or change its coordinates, then edit the slope \(k\) or intercept \(n\). Observe the slope triangle, equation, and displayed \(\Delta x,\Delta y\). How does moving a point change the slope when the two points have different x-coordinates and determine a nonzero input change?

title.en: Functions are rules with a domain

goal.sl: Premakni drsnik osnove \(a\) pod ali nad \(1\), nato v delovnem prostoru vključi zrcalni graf. Opazuj, da glavna krivulja vedno gre skozi \((0,1)\) in \((1,a)\), zrcalna pa ima osnovo \(1/a\). Kako točki in smer krivulje pokažeta razliko med rastjo in padanjem?
goal.en: Move the base slider \(a\) below or above \(1\), then turn on the mirror graph in the workspace. Observe that the main curve always passes through \((0,1)\) and \((1,a)\), while the mirror uses base \(1/a\). How do those points and the curve’s direction distinguish growth from decay?

title.en: Functions are rules with a domain

goal.sl: Izberi sinus, kosinus ali tangens; nato spremeni drsnike amplitude \(A\), frekvence \(\omega\), faze \(\varphi\) in srednje črte \(B\), po želji pa vključi referenčni graf. Opazuj spremembo višine, periode, vodoravnega zamika in srednje črte; pri tangensu opazuj ločene veje ob asimptotah. Kateri parameter je povzročil vsako opaženo spremembo?
goal.en: Select sine, cosine, or tangent; then change the amplitude \(A\), frequency \(\omega\), phase \(\varphi\), and midline \(B\) sliders, and optionally show the reference graph. Observe the height, period, horizontal shift, and midline; for tangent, notice the separate branches at its asymptotes. Which parameter caused each change you observed?

goal.sl: Linearna funkcija ima enačbo \(y=kx+n\), njen graf pa je premica. Premico določata dve točki z različnima koordinatama \(x\): premakni \(P_1\) in \(P_2\) ter opazuj, kako premica sledi točkama.
goal.en: A linear function has the equation \(y=kx+n\), and its graph is a line. Two points with different \(x\)-coordinates determine the line: move \(P_1\) and \(P_2\) and watch the line follow them.

goal.sl: Eksponentna funkcija \(f(x)=a^x\) ima pozitivno osnovo \(a\). Ker je \(a^0=1\), graf vedno poteka skozi \((0,1)\); ker je \(a^1=a\), je druga označena točka \((1,a)\). Premikaj drsnik osnove in opazuj, kaj se spreminja in kaj ne.
goal.en: The exponential function \(f(x)=a^x\) has a positive base \(a\). Since \(a^0=1\), the graph always passes through \((0,1)\); since \(a^1=a\), the second marked point is \((1,a)\). Move the base slider and watch what changes and what does not.

goal.sl: Pri privzetih nastavitvah \(A=1\), \(\omega=1\), \(\varphi=0\) in \(B=0\) je \(f(x)=\sin x\). Val se ponovi vsakih \(2\pi\approx6{,}28\) in nikoli ne preseže vrednosti \(1\) ali pade pod \(-1\). Poskusi spremeniti drsnike, nato pa se vrni na te vrednosti.
goal.en: With the default settings \(A=1\), \(\omega=1\), \(\varphi=0\) and \(B=0\) we have \(f(x)=\sin x\). The wave repeats every \(2\pi\approx6.28\) and never rises above \(1\) or falls below \(-1\). Try the sliders, then return to these values.

goal.sl: Premakni drsnik parametra \(a\) in pri \(a=1\) primerjaj zapolnjeno vrednost \(f(1)\) z levo in desno limito v izpisu; nato nastavi \(a=1{,}5\), ko se vrednosti ujemajo. Opazuj tudi naklona ob spoju. Kaj ti graf pomaga opaziti o skoku in o zveznosti, česa pa končen prikaz ne more potrditi za vsako bližnjo točko?
goal.en: Move the parameter slider \(a\). At \(a=1\), compare the filled value \(f(1)\) with the left and right limits in the readout; then set \(a=1.5\), where the values agree. Also observe the slopes at the join. What can the graph help you notice about the jump and continuity, and what can a finite view not establish for every nearby input?

goal.sl: Funkcija ima dva predpisa: \(f(x)=ax^2\) za \(x\le1\) in \(f(x)=-ax+3\) za \(x>1\). Točka \(x=1\) spada v levi del, zato je \(f(1)=a\cdot1^2=a\); pri privzetem \(a=1\) je \(f(1)=1\). Zapolnjena točka \((1,a)\) kaže to vrednost. Desni del se začne šele desno od \(x=1\).
goal.en: The function has two rules: \(f(x)=ax^2\) for \(x\le1\) and \(f(x)=-ax+3\) for \(x>1\). The point \(x=1\) belongs to the left piece, so \(f(1)=a\cdot1^2=a\); for the default \(a=1\) we get \(f(1)=1\). The filled point \((1,a)\) shows this value. The right piece starts only to the right of \(x=1\).

goal.sl: V izbirniku izberi \(f(x)=x^2\), nastavi \(x_0=1\), za začetek pusti neničelni \(h=1\), nato premikaj drsnik \(h\) proti nič z obeh strani in vključi stikalo tangente. Opazuj sekantni naklon, količnik in tangentni naklon v izpisu. Kako se sekanta približuje tangenti, in zakaj izračun količnika še vedno zahteva \(h\ne0\)?
goal.en: Choose \(f(x)=x^2\), set \(x_0=1\), keep the nonzero value \(h=1\) initially, then move the \(h\) slider toward zero from either side and turn on the tangent switch. title.sl: Bisekcija in izrek o vmesni vrednosti
title.en: Bisection and the intermediate value theorem

goal.sl: Funkcija \(f(x)=x^2-2\) je zvezna, na krajiščih intervala \([1,2]\) pa je \(f(1)=-1<0\) in \(f(2)=2>0\). Zvezna funkcija ne more preskočiti vrednosti \(0\), zato po izreku o vmesni vrednosti v intervalu leži vsaj ena ničla. Izrek zagotavlja obstoj, ne pa enoličnosti: ničel je lahko več. Bisekcija ničlo išče tako, da interval razpolavlja in vedno obdrži polovico, v kateri imata vrednosti v krajiščih še vedno nasprotna predznaka.
goal.en: The function \(f(x)=x^2-2\) is continuous, and at the ends of the interval \([1,2]\) we have \(f(1)=-1<0\) and \(f(2)=2>0\). A continuous function cannot skip the value \(0\), so by the intermediate value theorem the interval contains at least one root. The theorem guarantees existence, not uniqueness: there may be several roots. Bisection looks for a root by halving the interval and always keeping the half in which the endpoint values still have opposite signs.

goal.sl: Funkcija \(f(x)=x^2\) je zvezna na \([0,2]\) in odvedljiva na \((0,2)\). Sekanta povezuje točki \((0,f(0))\) in \((2,f(2))\) in ima naklon \(\frac{f(2)-f(0)}{2-0}=\frac{4-0}{2}=2\). Tangenta v točki \(c\in(0,2)\) ima naklon \(f^{\prime}(c)=2c\); pri \(c=0{,}5\) je ta naklon \(1\), razlika med naklonom tangente in naklonom sekante pa \(-1\). Krajišči \(a\) in \(b\) ter točko \(c\) premikaš vsako zase, vedno pa velja \(a<c<b\). Izrek o povprečni vrednosti trdi, da pri zvezni in na \((a,b)\) odvedljivi funkciji obstaja vsaj ena točka \(c\), v kateri sta naklona enaka.

The mean value theorem says that for a function that is continuous and differentiable on \((a,b)\) there is at least one point \(c\) at which the two slopes are equal.

The secant joins the points \((0,f(0))\) and \((2,f(2))\) and has slope \(\frac{f(2)-f(0)}{2-0}=\frac{4-0}{2}=2\). The tangent at a point \(c\in(0,2)\) has slope \(f^{\prime}(c)=2c\); at \(c=0.5\) this slope is \(1\), and the difference between the tangent slope and the secant slope is \(-1\). You move the endpoints \(a\) and \(b\) and the point \(c\) separately, and \(a<c<b\) always holds. The mean value theorem says that for a function that is continuous and differentiable on \((a,b)\) there is at least one point \(c\) at which the two slopes are equal.

goal.sl: Opazujemo \(f(x)=x^2\) na zaprtem intervalu \([-1,2]\). Kandidati so krajišči \(-1\) in \(2\), stacionarna točka \(0\), kjer je \(f^{\prime}(x)=2x=0\), in točke, kjer odvod ne obstaja; teh tu ni. Na vrhu grafa je predznak odvoda na vsakem delu med kandidati: \(-\) na \((-1,0)\) in \(+\) na \((0,2)\). Dogovor: lokalni ekstremi so glede na izbrani interval, zato v krajišču primerjamo vrednosti samo na strani, ki leži v intervalu. Klasifikacija je zdaj skrita; kandidati so označeni, a še ne razvrščeni.
goal.en: We look at \(f(x)=x^2\) on the closed interval \([-1,2]\). The candidates are the endpoints \(-1\) and \(2\), the stationary point \(0\) where \(f^{\prime}(x)=2x=0\), and the points where the derivative does not exist; there are none here. At the top of the graph is the sign of the derivative on each piece between the candidates: \(-\) on \((-1,0)\) and \(+\) on \((0,2)\). The convention: local extrema are relative to the selected interval, so at an endpoint the values are compared only on the side that lies in the interval. The classification is hidden now; the candidates are marked but not yet sorted.

goal.sl: Funkcija je konveksna na intervalu, če graf na njem med poljubnima dvema svojima točkama nikjer ne leži nad tetivo, ki ju povezuje, in konkavna, če nikjer ne leži pod njo. Drugi odvod \(f^{\prime\prime}\) je odvod odvoda \(f^{\prime}\): pove, kako se spreminja naklon tangente. Opazujemo \(f(x)=x^2\) na \([-1;1{,}5]\). Modra polna črta je tetiva med točkama grafa nad \(a=-1\) in \(b=1{,}5\), oranžna črtkana črta pa tangenta v točki \(t=0{,}5\). Drugi odvod je skrit, zato sklepa še ni.
goal.en: A function is convex on an interval if on it the graph never lies above a chord joining two of its points, between those two points, and concave if the graph never lies below a chord. The second derivative \(f^{\prime\prime}\) is the derivative of the derivative \(f^{\prime}\): it tells how the slope of the tangent changes. We look at \(f(x)=x^2\) on \([-1,1.5]\). The blue solid line is the chord between the points of the graph above \(a=-1\) and \(b=1.5\), and the orange dashed line is the tangent at \(t=0.5\). The second derivative is hidden, so there is no verdict yet.

goal.sl: Izberi funkcijo, spremeni središče, točko \(x\) in stopnjo \(n\); primerjaj funkcijo s Taylorjevim polinomom, nato razkrij oceno napake. Opazuj dejansko razliko pri \(x\) in pogoje za Lagrangeevo mejo med središčem in točko. Zakaj bližina krivulj v končnem grafu sama ne zagotavlja lokalne ali globalne meje?
goal.en: Select a function, change its center, point \(x\), and degree \(n\); compare the function with its Taylor polynomial, then reveal the error bound. Observe the actual difference at \(x\) and the conditions for the Lagrange bound between the center and the point. Why does closeness in a finite graph alone give neither a local nor a global error bound?

title.en: Taylor polynomial and the error of the approximation

goal.sl: Kako blizu lahko polinom pride funkciji \(e^x\)? Potrebuješ višje odvode \(f^{(k)}(c)\) in fakultete \(k!\). Središče \(c\) pove, kje se polinom ujema s funkcijo in njenimi odvodi; stopnja \(n\) določa, koliko členov uporabimo. Pri \(e^x\) okoli \(c=0\) je vsak odvod v središču enak \(1\). V točki \(x=1\) boš najprej primerjal stopnje \(1\), \(2\) in \(3\), nato stopnjo \(6\), preden razkriješ oceno napake.
goal.en: How closely can a polynomial follow \(e^x\)? You need higher derivatives \(f^{(k)}(c)\) and factorials \(k!\). The center \(c\) tells us where the polynomial matches the function and its derivatives; the degree \(n\) determines how many terms we use. For \(e^x\) about \(c=0\), every derivative at the center equals \(1\). At \(x=1\) you will first compare degrees \(1\), \(2\) and \(3\), then degree \(6\), before revealing the error bound.

goal.sl: Izberi številčno zaporedje, spremeni toleranco \(\varepsilon\), kandidatno limito \(L\) in prag \(N\); napovej, nato pokaži certifikat. title.en: Convergence of a sequence: ε and N

goal.sl: Zaporedje \(a_n=\frac1n\) ima neskončno mnogo členov: \(1\), \(\frac12\), \(\frac13\), … Kandidat za limito je \(L=0\). Definicija pravi: za vsak \(\varepsilon>0\) obstaja \(N\), da je \(|a_n-L|<\varepsilon\) za vsak \(n\ge N\). Najprej je izbran \(\varepsilon\), šele nato iščemo \(N\), ki je odvisen od njega, pogoj pa mora veljati za vse \(n\ge N\). Na grafu je zeleno osenčen pas med \(L-\varepsilon\) in \(L+\varepsilon\), pri izbranem \(\varepsilon=\frac14\) torej med \(-0{,}25\) in \(0{,}25\); pas je odprt. Člen v pasu je poln krogec, člen izven njega križec. Prikazanih je prvih dvanajst členov. Člen \(a_4=0{,}25\) leži natanko na robu pasu, zato ni v njem, od \(a_5=0{,}2\) naprej pa so prikazani členi v pasu. Certifikat je skrit. Prikazani členi sami konvergence ne dokažejo: da tudi vsi neprikazani členi od \(n=5\) naprej ležijo v pasu, pove šele obrazec.
goal.en: The sequence \(a_n=\frac1n\) has infinitely many terms: \(1\), \(\frac12\), \(\frac13\), … The candidate limit is \(L=0\). The definition says: for every \(\varepsilon>0\) there is an \(N\) such that \(|a_n-L|<\varepsilon\) for every \(n\ge N\). First \(\varepsilon\) is chosen, only then do we look for an \(N\) that depends on it, and the condition must hold for all \(n\ge N\). The graph shows the band between \(L-\varepsilon\) and \(L+\varepsilon\) shaded, so for the chosen \(\varepsilon=\frac14\) between \(-0.25\) and \(0.25\); the band is open. A term inside the band is a filled circle, a term outside it a cross. The first twelve terms are shown. The term \(a_4=0.25\) lies exactly on the edge of the band, so it is not in it, and from \(a_5=0.2\) on the shown terms are in the band. The certificate is hidden. The shown terms alone do not prove convergence: that all the unshown terms from \(n=5\) on also lie in the band is stated only by the formula.

title.sl: Enakomerna konvergenca: en skupni prag za vse točke
title.en: Uniform convergence: one shared threshold for all points

goal.sl: Začnemo z zaporedjem funkcij \(f_n(x)=\frac xn\) na območju \([0;\,1]\). Za vsak \(x\) gre \(\frac xn\) proti \(0\), zato je limita \(f(x)=0\) povsod, brez skoka. Okoli limite je pas \(\varepsilon=0{,}1\) na vsako stran. Izbrana točka \(x=0{,}5\) ima pri \(n=4\) napako \(|f_4(0{,}5)-0|=0{,}125\), kar je izven pasu. Točkovni prag \(N(x)\) je najmanjši \(n\), od katerega naprej je napaka v tej točki manjša od \(\varepsilon\). Enakomerna konvergenca zahteva več: en \(N\), ki deluje za vse \(x\) iz \([0;\,1]\) hkrati, zato mora biti manjša od \(\varepsilon\) največja napaka po vseh točkah, supremum \(\sup|f_n-f|\). Vprašanji sta: kje na območju je pri \(n=4\) napaka največja in koliko je, ter najmanj kolikšen \(n\) naredi vse napake manjše od \(\varepsilon\). Supremum je skrit in se računa po obrazcu, ne iz vzorčenih točk.
goal.en: We start with the sequence of functions \(f_n(x)=\frac xn\) on the domain \([0,1]\). For every \(x\), \(\frac xn\) tends to \(0\), so the limit is \(f(x)=0\) everywhere, without a jump. Around the limit there is a band of \(\varepsilon=0.1\) on each side. The chosen point \(x=0.5\) has at \(n=4\) the error \(|f_4(0.5)-0|=0.125\), which is outside the band. The pointwise threshold \(N(x)\) is the least \(n\) from which on the error at this point is below \(\varepsilon\). Uniform convergence asks for more: a single \(N\) that works for all \(x\) in \([0,1]\) at once, so the largest error over all points, the supremum \(\sup|f_n-f|\), has to be below \(\varepsilon\). The questions are: where on the domain the error at \(n=4\) is largest and how large it is, and what the least \(n\) is that makes all errors below \(\varepsilon\). The supremum is hidden and is computed from the formula, not from sampled points.

goal.sl: Preslikava \(T(x)=\frac{x+1}{2}\) slika interval \([0;\,2]\) vase. Negibna točka \(x^*\) reši \(T(x^*)=x^*\): na grafu je to presečišče krivulje \(y=T(x)\) z diagonalo \(y=x\), označeno s križcem, tu \(x^*=1\). Iteracija izhaja iz začetka \(x_0\) in računa \(x_{k+1}=T(x_k)\); vsak približek je vrednost sestavljene preslikave, \(x_2=T(T(x_0))\), zaporedje \(x_k\) pa je običajno zaporedje, zato je njegova konvergenca isto vprašanje kot v lekciji o zaporedjih. Pajkova mreža iz točke \((x_k,x_k)\) na diagonali gre navpično do krivulje, nato vodoravno nazaj do diagonale. Zdaj je prikazan le začetek \(x_0=0\) pri koraku \(0\); korak \(0\) še nima črt.
goal.en: The map \(T(x)=\frac{x+1}{2}\) maps the interval \([0,2]\) into itself. A fixed point \(x^*\) solves \(T(x^*)=x^*\): on the graph it is the intersection of the curve \(y=T(x)\) with the diagonal \(y=x\), marked by a cross, here \(x^*=1\). The iteration starts at \(x_0\) and computes \(x_{k+1}=T(x_k)\); every iterate is a value of a composed map, \(x_2=T(T(x_0))\), and the sequence \(x_k\) is an ordinary sequence, so its convergence is the same question as in the lesson on sequences. The cobweb goes from the point \((x_k,x_k)\) on the diagonal vertically to the curve and then horizontally back to the diagonal. Now only the start \(x_0=0\) is shown at step \(0\); step \(0\) has no segments yet.

title.sl: Bisekcija in izrek o vmesni vrednosti
title.en: Bisection and the intermediate value theorem

goal.sl: Funkcija \(f(x)=x^2-2\) je zvezna, na krajiščih intervala \([1,2]\) pa je \(f(1)=-1<0\) in \(f(2)=2>0\). Zvezna funkcija ne more preskočiti vrednosti \(0\), zato po izreku o vmesni vrednosti v intervalu leži vsaj ena ničla. Izrek zagotavlja obstoj, ne pa enoličnosti: ničel je lahko več. Bisekcija ničlo išče tako, da interval razpolavlja in vedno obdrži polovico, v kateri imata vrednosti v krajiščih še vedno nasprotna predznaka.
goal.en: The function \(f(x)=x^2-2\) is continuous, and at the ends of the interval \([1,2]\) we have \(f(1)=-1<0\) and \(f(2)=2>0\). A continuous function cannot skip the value \(0\), so by the intermediate value theorem the interval contains at least one root. The theorem guarantees existence, not uniqueness: there may be several roots. Bisection looks for a root by halving the interval and always keeping the half in which the endpoint values still have opposite signs.

goal.sl: Funkcija \(f(x)=x^2\) je zvezna na \([0,2]\) in odvedljiva na \((0,2)\). Sekanta povezuje točki \((0,f(0))\) in \((2,f(2))\) in ima naklon \(\frac{f(2)-f(0)}{2-0}=\frac{4-0}{2}=2\). Tangenta v točki \(c\in(0,2)\) ima naklon \(f^{\prime}(c)=2c\); pri \(c=0{,}5\) je ta naklon \(1\), razlika med naklonom tangente in naklonom sekante pa \(-1\). Krajišči \(a\) in \(b\) ter točko \(c\) premikaš vsako zase, vedno pa velja \(a<c<b\). Izrek o povprečni vrednosti trdi, da pri zvezni in na \((a,b)\) odvedljivi funkciji obstaja vsaj ena točka \(c\), v kateri sta naklona enaka.
goal.en: The function \(f(x)=x^2\) is continuous on \([0,2]\) and differentiable on \((0,2)\). The secant joins the points \((0,f(0))\) and \((2,f(2))\) and has slope \(\frac{f(2)-f(0)}{2-0}=\frac{4-0}{2}=2\). The tangent at a point \(c\in(0,2)\) has slope \(f^{\prime}(c)=2c\); at \(c=0.5\) this slope is \(1\), and the difference between the tangent slope and the secant slope is \(-1\). You move the endpoints \(a\) and \(b\) and the point \(c\) separately, and \(a<c<b\) always holds. The mean value theorem says that for a function that is continuous and differentiable on \((a,b)\) there is at least one point \(c\) at which the two slopes are equal.

title.en: The accumulated integral and the fundamental theorem

goal.sl: Funkcija \(f(x)=\sin x\) je zvezna, spodnja meja je \(a=0\) in točka je \(x=2\). Akumulacija \(A(x)=\int_a^x f(t)\,dt\) je integral s predznakom od \(a\) do \(x\): osenčeno območje med grafom in osjo \(x\) šteje pozitivno nad osjo (oznaka +) in negativno pod njo (oznaka −). Krivulja \(A\) je za zdaj skrita. Pri \(x=2\) leži vse območje nad osjo, ker je \(\sin t>0\) za \(t\in(0,2)\), zato mora biti \(A(2)\) pozitivna in manjša od \(2\), kolikor meri celoten lok sinusa nad \([0,\pi]\).
goal.en: The function \(f(x)=\sin x\) is continuous, the lower bound is \(a=0\) and the point is \(x=2\). The accumulation \(A(x)=\int_a^x f(t)\,dt\) is the signed integral from \(a\) to \(x\): the shaded region between the graph and the \(x\)-axis counts as positive above the axis (marked +) and as negative below it (marked −). The curve \(A\) is hidden for now. At \(x=2\) the whole region lies above the axis, because \(\sin t>0\) for \(t\in(0,2)\), so \(A(2)\) must be positive and smaller than \(2\), the measure of the whole arc of the sine over \([0,\pi]\).

goal.sl: Interval \([0,2]\) razdelimo na \(n=4\) enake dele širine \(\Delta x=\frac{2-0}{4}=\frac12\) z delilnimi točkami \(0,\frac12,1,\frac32,2\). Na vsakem delu je infimum \(m_i\) največja spodnja meja vrednosti funkcije \(f(x)=x^2\), supremum \(M_i\) pa najmanjša zgornja meja. Spodnja vsota je \(L=\sum m_i\,\Delta x\), zgornja pa \(U=\sum M_i\,\Delta x\). Obe vsoti sta zdaj skriti; vidiš le delilne točke in natančni integral.
goal.en: The interval \([0,2]\) is split into \(n=4\) equal parts of width \(\Delta x=\frac{2-0}{4}=\frac12\) with the dividing points \(0,\frac12,1,\frac32,2\). On every part the infimum \(m_i\) is the greatest lower bound of the values of \(f(x)=x^2\), and the supremum \(M_i\) is the least upper bound. The lower sum is \(L=\sum m_i\,\Delta x\) and the upper sum is \(U=\sum M_i\,\Delta x\). Both sums are hidden now; you see only the dividing points and the exact integral.

goal.sl: Opazujemo \(f(x)=x^2\) na zaprtem intervalu \([-1,2]\). Kandidati so krajišči \(-1\) in \(2\), stacionarna točka \(0\), kjer je \(f^{\prime}(x)=2x=0\), in točke, kjer odvod ne obstaja; teh tu ni. Na vrhu grafa je predznak odvoda na vsakem delu med kandidati: \(-\) na \((-1,0)\) in \(+\) na \((0,2)\). Dogovor: lokalni ekstremi so glede na izbrani interval, zato v krajišču primerjamo vrednosti samo na strani, ki leži v intervalu. Klasifikacija je zdaj skrita; kandidati so označeni, a še ne razvrščeni.
goal.en: We look at \(f(x)=x^2\) on the closed interval \([-1,2]\). The candidates are the endpoints \(-1\) and \(2\), the stationary point \(0\) where \(f^{\prime}(x)=2x=0\), and the points where the derivative does not exist; there are none here. At the top of the graph is the sign of the derivative on each piece between the candidates: \(-\) on \((-1,0)\) and \(+\) on \((0,2)\). The convention: local extrema are relative to the selected interval, so at an endpoint the values are compared only on the side that lies in the interval. The classification is hidden now; the candidates are marked but not yet sorted.

goal.sl: Funkcija je konveksna na intervalu, če graf na njem med poljubnima dvema svojima točkama nikjer ne leži nad tetivo, ki ju povezuje, in konkavna, če nikjer ne leži pod njo. Drugi odvod \(f^{\prime\prime}\) je odvod odvoda \(f^{\prime}\): pove, kako se spreminja naklon tangente. Opazujemo \(f(x)=x^2\) na \([-1;1{,}5]\). Modra polna črta je tetiva med točkama grafa nad \(a=-1\) in \(b=1{,}5\), oranžna črtkana črta pa tangenta v točki \(t=0{,}5\). Drugi odvod je skrit, zato sklepa še ni.
goal.en: A function is convex on an interval if on it the graph never lies above a chord joining two of its points, between those two points, and concave if the graph never lies below a chord. The second derivative \(f^{\prime\prime}\) is the derivative of the derivative \(f^{\prime}\): it tells how the slope of the tangent changes. We look at \(f(x)=x^2\) on \([-1,1.5]\). The blue solid line is the chord between the points of the graph above \(a=-1\) and \(b=1.5\), and the orange dashed line is the tangent at \(t=0.5\). The second derivative is hidden, so there is no verdict yet.

title.en: Taylor polynomial and the error of the approximation

goal.sl: Kako blizu lahko polinom pride funkciji \(e^x\)? Potrebuješ višje odvode \(f^{(k)}(c)\) in fakultete \(k!\). Središče \(c\) pove, kje se polinom ujema s funkcijo in njenimi odvodi; stopnja \(n\) določa, koliko členov uporabimo. Pri \(e^x\) okoli \(c=0\) je vsak odvod v središču enak \(1\). V točki \(x=1\) boš najprej primerjal stopnje \(1\), \(2\) in \(3\), nato stopnjo \(6\), preden razkriješ oceno napake.
goal.en: How closely can a polynomial follow \(e^x\)? You need higher derivatives \(f^{(k)}(c)\) and factorials \(k!\). The center \(c\) tells us where the polynomial matches the function and its derivatives; the degree \(n\) determines how many terms we use. For \(e^x\) about \(c=0\), every derivative at the center equals \(1\). At \(x=1\) you will first compare degrees \(1\), \(2\) and \(3\), then degree \(6\), before revealing the error bound.

title.en: Convergence of a sequence: ε and N

goal.sl: Zaporedje \(a_n=\frac1n\) ima neskončno mnogo členov: \(1\), \(\frac12\), \(\frac13\), … Kandidat za limito je \(L=0\). Definicija pravi: za vsak \(\varepsilon>0\) obstaja \(N\), da je \(|a_n-L|<\varepsilon\) za vsak \(n\ge N\). Najprej je izbran \(\varepsilon\), šele nato iščemo \(N\), ki je odvisen od njega, pogoj pa mora veljati za vse \(n\ge N\). Na grafu je zeleno osenčen pas med \(L-\varepsilon\) in \(L+\varepsilon\), pri izbranem \(\varepsilon=\frac14\) torej med \(-0{,}25\) in \(0{,}25\); pas je odprt. Člen v pasu je poln krogec, člen izven njega križec. Prikazanih je prvih dvanajst členov. Člen \(a_4=0{,}25\) leži natanko na robu pasu, zato ni v njem, od \(a_5=0{,}2\) naprej pa so prikazani členi v pasu. Certifikat je skrit. Prikazani členi sami konvergence ne dokažejo: da tudi vsi neprikazani členi od \(n=5\) naprej ležijo v pasu, pove šele obrazec.
goal.en: The sequence \(a_n=\frac1n\) has infinitely many terms: \(1\), \(\frac12\), \(\frac13\), … The candidate limit is \(L=0\). The definition says: for every \(\varepsilon>0\) there is an \(N\) such that \(|a_n-L|<\varepsilon\) for every \(n\ge N\). First \(\varepsilon\) is chosen, only then do we look for an \(N\) that depends on it, and the condition must hold for all \(n\ge N\). The graph shows the band between \(L-\varepsilon\) and \(L+\varepsilon\) shaded, so for the chosen \(\varepsilon=\frac14\) between \(-0.25\) and \(0.25\); the band is open. A term inside the band is a filled circle, a term outside it a cross. The first twelve terms are shown. The term \(a_4=0.25\) lies exactly on the edge of the band, so it is not in it, and from \(a_5=0.2\) on the shown terms are in the band. The certificate is hidden. The shown terms alone do not prove convergence: that all the unshown terms from \(n=5\) on also lie in the band is stated only by the formula.

title.sl: Enakomerna konvergenca: en skupni prag za vse točke
title.en: Uniform convergence: one shared threshold for all points

goal.sl: Začnemo z zaporedjem funkcij \(f_n(x)=\frac xn\) na območju \([0;\,1]\). Za vsak \(x\) gre \(\frac xn\) proti \(0\), zato je limita \(f(x)=0\) povsod, brez skoka. Okoli limite je pas \(\varepsilon=0{,}1\) na vsako stran. Izbrana točka \(x=0{,}5\) ima pri \(n=4\) napako \(|f_4(0{,}5)-0|=0{,}125\), kar je izven pasu. Točkovni prag \(N(x)\) je najmanjši \(n\), od katerega naprej je napaka v tej točki manjša od \(\varepsilon\). Enakomerna konvergenca zahteva več: en \(N\), ki deluje za vse \(x\) iz \([0;\,1]\) hkrati, zato mora biti manjša od \(\varepsilon\) največja napaka po vseh točkah, supremum \(\sup|f_n-f|\). Vprašanji sta: kje na območju je pri \(n=4\) napaka največja in koliko je, ter najmanj kolikšen \(n\) naredi vse napake manjše od \(\varepsilon\). Supremum je skrit in se računa po obrazcu, ne iz vzorčenih točk.
goal.en: We start with the sequence of functions \(f_n(x)=\frac xn\) on the domain \([0,1]\). For every \(x\), \(\frac xn\) tends to \(0\), so the limit is \(f(x)=0\) everywhere, without a jump. Around the limit there is a band of \(\varepsilon=0.1\) on each side. The chosen point \(x=0.5\) has at \(n=4\) the error \(|f_4(0.5)-0|=0.125\), which is outside the band. The pointwise threshold \(N(x)\) is the least \(n\) from which on the error at this point is below \(\varepsilon\). Uniform convergence asks for more: a single \(N\) that works for all \(x\) in \([0,1]\) at once, so the largest error over all points, the supremum \(\sup|f_n-f|\), has to be below \(\varepsilon\). The questions are: where on the domain the error at \(n=4\) is largest and how large it is, and what the least \(n\) is that makes all errors below \(\varepsilon\). The supremum is hidden and is computed from the formula, not from sampled points.

goal.sl: Preslikava \(T(x)=\frac{x+1}{2}\) slika interval \([0;\,2]\) vase. Negibna točka \(x^*\) reši \(T(x^*)=x^*\): na grafu je to presečišče krivulje \(y=T(x)\) z diagonalo \(y=x\), označeno s križcem, tu \(x^*=1\). Iteracija izhaja iz začetka \(x_0\) in računa \(x_{k+1}=T(x_k)\); vsak približek je vrednost sestavljene preslikave, \(x_2=T(T(x_0))\), zaporedje \(x_k\) pa je običajno zaporedje, zato je njegova konvergenca isto vprašanje kot v lekciji o zaporedjih. Pajkova mreža iz točke \((x_k,x_k)\) na diagonali gre navpično do krivulje, nato vodoravno nazaj do diagonale. Zdaj je prikazan le začetek \(x_0=0\) pri koraku \(0\); korak \(0\) še nima črt.
goal.en: The map \(T(x)=\frac{x+1}{2}\) maps the interval \([0,2]\) into itself. A fixed point \(x^*\) solves \(T(x^*)=x^*\): on the graph it is the intersection of the curve \(y=T(x)\) with the diagonal \(y=x\), marked by a cross, here \(x^*=1\). The iteration starts at \(x_0\) and computes \(x_{k+1}=T(x_k)\); every iterate is a value of a composed map, \(x_2=T(T(x_0))\), and the sequence \(x_k\) is an ordinary sequence, so its convergence is the same question as in the lesson on sequences. The cobweb goes from the point \((x_k,x_k)\) on the diagonal vertically to the curve and then horizontally back to the diagonal. Now only the start \(x_0=0\) is shown at step \(0\); step \(0\) has no segments yet.
